description: Use when the user wants to show you something instead of typing it ("let me show you", "watch this", a bug they can reproduce, a design or product review). Returns a recording link for the user to open: they record their screen and talk through what should change, then press Stop. Then call get_change_list with the job id to receive the change list (it waits for them).
name: record_screen
title: Ask the user to show you on screen
